decisions.statement: Reading a property's values back for a test is done here rather than by each test.
A property whose page type is `page-property-entry` keeps its values beside the page.
A file's name is the page's name followed by the property's slug and the extension stated.
A blank line has no value.
A file the page names that is not there is refused rather than read as holding nothing.
A line that is no JSON object is refused rather than left out.
An empty file is answered with an empty list rather than refused.
The values read here are written over the extension the page states.
A property's values may be kept in the numbered files beside the page.
The values of one property are read in the order the files are numbered.
The first file of a property not held uncommitted is refused where no file is there.
A property held uncommitted is read from the files whose names say so.
A property held uncommitted whose first file is not there holds no value.
Reading stops at the first numbered file that is not there.
A caller handing in how a body is read is answered from those bodies rather than off the disk.
A body a caller hands in that holds no JSON object is passed over there.
A caller handing in a way to be told is told the name of every file passed over.
A file that would not open is told apart from a file that holds no JSON object.
A caller naming which properties it wants has the files of no other property read.
A caller naming no properties has every entry property's files read.
Nothing here reads the index.
Nothing here writes.

definition: the values a page keeps one to a line in a file beside the page
